subject.title: feat(trajectory): allow OPENCLAW_TRAJECTORY_RUNTIME_EVENT_MAX_BYTES override for per-event byte cap

question: Should OpenClaw support an operator-controlled per-event trajectory-size override, rather than retaining the fixed 256 KiB diagnostic cap?
rationale: This is a new public environment/configuration capability, not a repair to an established broken contract; source review cannot decide the intended operational and support policy.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded override
options.body: Approve the capability, then require a rebase that threads the limit through the current preserved-field truncation implementations in both recorder paths.

options.title: Keep the fixed cap
options.body: Decline the new environment surface and retain the existing 256 KiB bounded diagnostic behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded override
recommendation.body: Approve the capability, then require a rebase that threads the limit through the current preserved-field truncation implementations in both recorder paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent trajectory maintenance makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the product and operational tradeoff.
